content.text:
Help me fix an issue happening in arrival board displays. 
Project: /modular-SWE/datasets/custom/problems/nexttube/implementations_noDesign/checkpoint_1

Given that the tfl api used for displaying live arrivals returns the following format in the /Arrivals endpoint: 
{
    "$type": "Tfl.Api.Presentation.Entities.Prediction, Tfl.Api.Presentation.Entities",
    "id": "-712910209",
    "operationType": 1,
    "vehicleId": "315",
    "naptanId": "940GZZLUBDS",
    "stationName": "Bounds Green Underground Station",
    "lineId": "piccadilly",
    "lineName": "Piccadilly",
    "platformName": "Westbound - Platform 2",
    "direction": "inbound",
    "bearing": "",
    "destinationNaptanId": "940GZZLUHR5",
    "destinationName": "Heathrow Terminal 5 Underground Station",
    "timestamp": "2026-08-09T22:18:59.6814658Z",
    "timeToStation": 68,
    "currentLocation": "Approaching Bounds Green",
    "towards": "Heathrow T123 + 5",
    "expectedArrival": "2026-08-09T22:20:07Z",
    "timeToLive": "2026-08-09T22:20:07Z",
    "modeName": "tube",
    "timing": {
      "$type": "Tfl.Api.Presentation.Entities.PredictionTiming, Tfl.Api.Presentation.Entities",
      "countdownServerAdjustment": "00:00:00",
      "source": "0001-01-01T00:00:00",
      "insert": "0001-01-01T00:00:00",
      "read": "2026-08-09T22:19:39.176Z",
      "sent": "2026-08-09T22:18:59Z",
      "received": "0001-01-01T00:00:00"
    }
  }

Currently, some stations are displayed as Unknown, and I realised that the destination seems to be translated from the destination station (naptan) ID. I want the "towards" string to be displayed as the destination instead as it includes more comprehensive information. Help me implement that change.

log.text: I found the server-side mapping in `arrivals.py`: it currently normalizes `destinationName` from the TfL payload and falls back to `"Unknown destination"`. I’m reading the model definitions next so I can switch this cleanly without breaking the response shape the frontend already expects.

log.aggregated_output:
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class TubeLine(BaseModel):
    id: str
    name: str
    color: str


class Station(BaseModel):
    id: str
    name: str
    lines: list[str]
    code: str


class StationSearchResult(BaseModel):
    id: str
    name: str
    code: str
    lines: list[TubeLine]


class ArrivalEntry(BaseModel):
    index: int
    destination_name: str = Field(alias="destinationName")
    minutes_text: str = Field(alias="minutesText")
    platform_numbers: str = Field(alias="platformNumbers")
    seconds_to_station: int = Field(alias="secondsToStation")


class DirectionBoard(BaseModel):
    direction: str
    arrivals: list[ArrivalEntry]


class ArrivalBoardResponse(BaseModel):
    station: StationSearchResult
    line: TubeLine
    boards: list[DirectionBoard]

log.text: The response contract can stay the same; I only need to change how the backend derives the value that fills `destinationName`. I’m patching `arrivals.py` to prefer `towards`, with `destinationName` as a fallback, so the frontend does not need any changes.

+
+
+def display_destination(arrival: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    return (
+        normalized_text(arrival.get("towards"))
+        or normalized_text(arrival.get("destinationName"))
+        or "Unknown destination"
+    )
